== Biography ==
{{Ireland Native}}

* '''Birth:''' About 1836.<ref>Based on death record, 1883, age 47.</ref>
* '''Parents:''' Son of [[Glasgow-3196|James Glasgow]], farmer, of Killycurragh. Residence in 1859 was Killycurragh.<ref name="mar"/>
* '''Marriage:''' On 29 Mar 1859 at Oritor Presbyterian Church, Kildress, David married [[Glasgow-1648|Mary Glasgow]] age 16 of Killycurragh, daughter of [[Glasgow-1654|David Glasgow]], farmer.<ref name="mar">[https://civilrecords.irishgenealogy.ie/churchrecords/details-civil/907b423288153 David Glasgow, Mary Glasgow, 29 Mar 1859, Cookstown] Irish Civil Registration, Marriages</ref>
* '''Residence:'''
** 1859 to 1877, Killycurragh. Children born here. [[Glasgow-1650|Sarah]] in 1877.
** By 1882, Ballynagilly. Daughter [[Glasgow-1649|Margaret]] born here.
* '''Death:''' 28 Sep 1883 at Ballynagilly, age 47.<ref>[https://civilrecords.irishgenealogy.ie/churchrecords/details-civil/fe048f6326580 David Glasgow, 1883, Cookstown, 47] Irish Civil Registration, Deaths</ref>

After David’s death, most of the children emigrated:
* [[Glasgow-2019|James George Glasgow]] to Lancashire
* [[Glasgow-919|Mary Jane  Glasgow]] to Australia
* [[Glasgow-1714|Martha Glasgow]], [[Glasgow-2036|David Glasgow]], [[Glasgow-2037|Ellen Glasgow]], [[Glasgow-1650|Sarah Glasgow]], [[Glasgow-1649|Margaret Glasgow]] to Pennsylvania

== Research Notes ==
=== Individual father review, 22 October 2026 ===

This dated review supersedes any earlier grade of this pair within the stated record scope. The existing father [[Glasgow-3196]] is assessed at 98% (proved). David’s 1859 marriage account directly identifies James Glasgow, farmer, as his father and gives the groom’s Killycurragh residence. The selected James profile is defined by this very record, so absence of his upstream ancestry does not weaken this natal relationship.

Held citation and associated historical narrative address this selected father-child identity; no original was newly inspected.

Next useful test: Inspect the full 1859 father line and witnesses.

Source basis already held: [https://civilrecords.irishgenealogy.ie/churchrecords/details-civil/907b423288153 * Marriage: On 29 Mar 1859 at Oritor Presbyterian Church, Kildress, David married Mary Glasgow age 16 of Killycurragh, daughter of David Glasgow, farmer. David Glasgow, Mary Glasgow, 29 Mar 1859, Cookstown (https://civilrecords.irishgenealogy.ie/churchrecords/details-civil/907b423288153) Irish Civil Registration, Marriages]. No new father attached; cited evidence and any inspected register entry are scoped above.



=== Other David Glasgows ===
Not to be confused with other men named David Glasgow in mid nineteenth century Tyrone:
* [[Glasgow-1644|David Glasgow]] about 1836 to 1915 of Killycurragh, married [[Bell-31286|Margaret Bell]] in 1857
* [[Glasgow-692|David Glasgow]] about 1833 to 1926 of Beltonanean, married [[Glasgow-693|Margaret Jane Glasgow]] in 1878
* [[Glasgow-1788|David Glasgow]] before 1835 of Killycurragh, son of [[Glasgow-1654|David Glasgow]]

There were at least four Davids in this era, two of Killycurragh, one of Beltonanean, one of Ballynasollus. See [[Glasgow-1644]] research notes.

=== Other records for this David ===
* Possible sister, [https://civilrecords.irishgenealogy.ie/churchrecords/details-civil/6567713134957 Mary Ann Glasgow], daughter of [[Glasgow-3196|James Glasgow]], resident at Ballynagilly in 1866, married David Bell of Dunmore

=== Moving to Ballynagilly ===
Evidence for this move:
* Daughter [[Glasgow-1650|Sarah]] born at Killycurragh in 1877
* Daughter [[Glasgow-1649|Margaret]] born at Ballynagilly in 1882
* Death records exist of the right age for David and Mary at Ballynagilly
* No matching death records exist for a David or a Mary of Killycurragh
** The 1915 death belongs to [[Glasgow-1644|David Glasgow of Killycurragh]] who married [[Bell-31286|Margaret Bell]]
* Mary’s death record named [[Glasgow-1651|Samuel Ramsey Glasgow]] as informant
** In 1895 Samuel married Annabella Crooks
** The [http://www.census.nationalarchives.ie/pages/1911/Tyrone/Lissan/Ballynagilly/858935/ 1901 census] shows Samuel, Annabella, and Mary age 68
* No civil birth record has been found for Samuel. This supports the unidentified child recorded for 1873 for this couple and makes Samuel the best candidate for that entry

=== His father ===
Further reading, [[Space:Glasgow_of_Killycurragh%2C_early_C19]]

In Griffiths Valuation there were:
* Two James in Ballynasollus, perhaps [[Glasgow-1702|James Glasgow]] about 1799 to 1882 and [[Glasgow-1681|James Glasgow]] about 1828 to 1907
* Four James in Killycurragh, [[Glasgow-1701|James Glasgow]] about 1805 to 1875, [[Glasgow-1702|James Glasgow]] about 1799 to 1882, and two others unknown

In the 1827 Tithe Applotment Book there was only one James Glasgow listed in the area.

Working hypothesis, [[Glasgow-1702|James Glasgow]] about 1799 to 1882 of Ballynasollus could be his father. This remains unproven.

So far no wills or obituaries have been found that confirm the parentage. Since most of David and Mary’s children emigrated, few obituary notices survive in Ireland.

The death of David Glasgow was registered on 28 September 1883 in Cookstown, aged 47.<ref>[https://geni.nidirect.gov.uk/search/death GRONI civil death index], David Glasgow, 28 September 1883, aged 47, Cookstown registration district, D/1883/99/1009/10/261.</ref>
